title: Dental and Eye Health Camp
summary: On 12–13 October 2026, RCMP facilitated a Dental and Eye Health Camp at Airport High School, Bamanwada, and Anandi School, Shahaji Raje Road.
description: On 12–13 October 2026, RCMP facilitated a Dental and Eye Health Camp at Airport High School, Bamanwada, and Anandi School, Shahaji Raje Road. At Airport High School, 1,444 students from Stds. 1 to 10 benefited, including around 40 severely autistic, largely non-verbal students. Children diagnosed with dental or eye issues can now get treatment at heavily subsidised rates. Parents attended awareness sessions that cleared up many misconceptions and fears. Thanks to Dr. Seema Patil, Mr. Chirag Gada and the OneDent and IMAX teams. The on-site medical team of PP Rtn. Dr. Monika Tandon and Rtn. Pooja Rane was ably supported by Pres. Sundeep Gokhale, First Lady Renuka Gokhale, PP Rtn. P. R. Sakthivel, RotAnn Dr. Veena Sakthivel, RotAnn Prerna Phadnis, Rtn. Saswata Banerjee, PP Rtn. Avinaash Mishra, RotAnn Vibha Mishra, PP Rtn. Moha Kamat and Rtn. Hemant Yenganti. We look forward to more volunteers at our next School Health Camp
location: Mumbai, Vile Parle, Airport School, Maharashtra
